name: robbiegal-tools
description: Robbie Galfrin's public Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: cutlist
plugins.description: Cut, grade, annotate, redact and mix a finished video from raw footage with ffmpeg, and prove the result frame by frame instead of trusting the exit code.

plugins.name: presentation-coach
plugins.description: Audit a rehearsal recording against its slide deck: timing, pace, fillers, slide/speech consistency and vocal delivery, tracked across dry runs.

plugins.name: tamlul
plugins.description: Transcribe and annotate Hebrew conversations locally: ivrit.ai Whisper + pyannote on CPU, speaker-attributed, timestamped and verbatim, with turns, overlaps, action items and summaries. Audio never leaves the machine.
